header.name: Print Fuuz Label
header.description: Use the Labeling Logic Control application configs

version.description: update query to remove old schema fields

data.query:
query Query($where: InventoryWhereInput, $orderBy: [InventoryOrderByInput!], $first: Int, $after: String) {
  inventory(where: $where, orderBy: $orderBy, first: $first, after: $after) {
  total
    edges {
      node {
        id
        number
        grossWeight
        netWeight
        tareWeight
        theoreticalWeight
        active
        barcode
        externalId
        note
        trackingNumber
        customData
        inventoryStatusId
        assetId
        inventoryTypeId
        itemShipmentLineId
        kanbanCardId
        locationId
        lotId
        masterInventoryId
        packagingMaterialId
        productId
        productStrategyProcessId
        productStrategyProcess {
          documentDesignId
          documentDesign {
            name
            active
          }
        }
        receiptLineId
        supplierId
        weightUnitId
        workOrderId
        workOrderProcessId
      }
    }
  }
}
